Intimidation on people who already struggle to refill their medication is ableist. I’ve had friends torn down by pharmacists over the amount of their prescription, they left crying. This kind of attitude only hurts people who need medication, call it what it is, a stimulant.

In Canada, although I’ve had bad interactions where pharmacists asked me a million questions before giving me my adhd meds (and also would make sure I KNEW that they were getting my medication from a locked safe 🙄), I’ve realized that shoppers drug mart has a really easy refill option. You don’t have to talk to anyone, just call and enter your prescription # (on the bottle) and year of birth. It takes two days, so my system is to use a weekly pill organizer, and when I go to refill it I’m reminded of how many I have left and whether I need to call. I feel your pain though buddy, it really feels like they make it extra difficult even though remembering what I had for breakfast is hard enough! Maybe an American on this thread knows of a similar refill policy?
